title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Heat Pump and Underfloor Heating Control: An End-to-End Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.23063v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient control of underfloor heating (UFH) systems coupled with heat pumps (HPs) is challenging due to the high thermal inertia of buildings and the slow dynamic response of UFH systems. Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a data-driven control approach capable of simultaneously optimizing energy consumption and thermal comfort. However, the application of DRL-based controllers in occupied buildings under real operating conditions remains limited. This work presents and end-to-end case study (development, evaluation, and real-world deployment) of a DRL-based controller for an integrated UFH-HP system. First, a simulation-based pilot study was conducted to assess different DRL algorithms, control strategies, and configurations. Subsequently, a digital twin of a real residential building was developed and used to train DRL agents under simulated operating conditions. The best-performing agent was then deployed in the physical build

translated_title: 面向热泵与地暖控制的深度强化学习：一项端到端案例研究
translated_abstract: 热泵（HP）与地暖（UFH）系统耦合运行的高效控制极具挑战性，其原因在于建筑的高热惯性和地暖系统缓慢的动态响应。深度强化学习（DRL）提供了一种数据驱动的控制方法，能够同时优化能耗与热舒适性。然而，基于DRL的控制器在真实运行条件下的有人居住建筑中的应用仍然有限。本工作针对一个集成的地暖-热泵系统，提出并开展了一项基于DRL控制器的端到端案例研究（涵盖开发、评估与实际部署）。首先，开展了基于仿真的试点研究，以评估不同的DRL算法、控制策略与配置方案。随后，开发了一个真实住宅建筑的数字孪生模型，并用其在模拟运行条件下训练DRL智能体。表现最佳的智能体随后被部署到实际建筑中。
tldr: 本研究针对热泵与地暖耦合系统提出了基于深度强化学习的端到端控制案例研究，利用真实住宅的数字孪生训练智能体并成功部署于实际建筑中，从而同时优化能耗与热舒适性。
en_tdlr: This study presents an end-to-end case study of a deep reinforcement learning controller for a coupled heat pump and underfloor heating system, trained on a digital twin of a real residential building and deployed in the actual building to simultaneously optimize energy consumption and thermal comfort.
